recommendation: Resolve and reconcile the existing ETH lifecycle under its unchanged native exit contract before evaluating another ETH change.
why_now: This is the first exact live V58 ETH activation and it is currently the highest-value source-compatible open lifecycle.
required_post_close_reconciliation: Match the exact lifecycle, run, profile, strategy, symbol, and side in the backend-authored closed trade row.
Reconcile entry and exit fills, gross market PnL, total fees, funding, and net PnL arithmetically.
Report exit reason, decision time, submission time, fill time, fill price, holding duration, and exit slippage.
Verify the live ETH position is flat and every owned ETH order, including the protective stop, is absent after close.
Verify the frozen append-only ledger prefixes remain byte-identical before consuming their appended exit tails.
Use actual live notional for dollar accounting and normalized basis points for comparison with the fixed 750-dollar observer.
Compare native realized economics with already frozen counterfactuals without selecting or tuning a new policy from this outcome.
success_metrics: Exact live lifecycle closes with complete and internally reconciled accounting.
Exit behavior matches the frozen 60-bps stop, eligible-opposite, or 12-hour maximum-hold contract.
No orphan ETH position or owned order remains.
Observer and live comparisons preserve their distinct notional and execution claims.
failure_or_update_triggers: Any identity, ledger-prefix, fill, accounting, exit-reason, or venue-state contradiction.
Missing exit depth, funding, fee, decision, submission, or order-cleanup evidence.
A changed live config, route, stop, hold, sizing, or execution contract before resolution.
Independent future both-side lifecycles or a preregistered state-aware exit provide materially stronger evidence.
next_action: Wait for the native close, then publish one source-bound reconciliation without changing live ETH.
